summary: This bill prohibits the Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Justice from using federal funds for civil immigration enforcement within one mile of any 2026 FIFA World Cup match or Fan Festival, except in exigent circumstances involving imminent risk to safety, national security, or destruction of evidence.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly restricts civil immigration enforcement activities within a specific radius of World Cup events, which would lead to less enforcement in those areas. This clearly pushes towards more immigration by limiting the ability to secure borders in certain contexts, even if temporarily and geographically limited.
